name: Build a Pika robot game
description: Knowledge pack for AI coding assistants: everything needed to design a browser demo, write or port a Pika Engine Lua game that runs on the real robot, and diagnose it, without inventing APIs. Read SKILL.md first. The SDK version is sdk_version at the SDK root; people start at ../docs/README.md.

load_values.on_demo: mode A: designing a browser demo on the kit
load_values.on_port: mode C: porting a kit demo to Lua
load_values.multi_scene: several screens, or more than ~300 lines
load_values.many_objects: many sprites, big art, or frame drops
load_values.on_error: any failure, odd behaviour or robot log (mode D)
load_values.on_warning: a ⚠️ label, or a fact the contract does not settle
load_values.on_task: the user's task matches the recipe's trigger

files.title: Build a Pika robot game
files.summary: Golden rules G1-G13 (rule, why, check), mode routing A-D, load table, pack and manifest essentials, minimal game, self-check loop and hand-off.

files.title: API contract
files.summary: Every API with signature, return, failure behaviour and the key rule; hooks and how they are bound; sandbox; calls that do not exist. Rendered from contract/semantics.json.

files.title: Hard constraints
files.summary: Every limit with its constraints.json key and what happens past it, design facts, known issues (KI-*) and PC-vs-robot gaps (PC-*).

files.title: Lua on the Pika Engine
files.summary: LUA-* rules: hooks at top level, handles referenced, 32-bit integers, nested C-call limit, Lua 5.5 differences, sandbox, where smoke differs from the robot.

files.title: Design a browser demo with the kit
files.summary: Mode A. Rules R1-R9, JS to Lua table, lint codes with severity, the S3 gate and the hand-off.

files.title: Port a kit demo to a Lua pack
files.summary: Mode C. PORT-* rules and the mechanical steps from a demo and pika-spec.json to a pack, through S5 and S6.

files.title: Game architecture
files.summary: ARCH-* rules: rules split from wiring, fixed step on Timer.millis(), scenes as state inside one on_tick, pools, layering, handle lifetime.

files.title: Performance and memory
files.summary: PERF-* rules: calls known to be expensive, send-if-changed, loading across frames, PSRAM budget, the display lock during a frame.

files.title: Shipped Lua libraries
files.summary: Exact exported functions of every module in libraries/, dependencies and caveats.

files.title: Pitfalls
files.summary: Symptom and log signature → cause → fix → evidence, one row per reproducible failure (P1-P35).

files.title: Open questions
files.summary: Questions the firmware does not settle yet, each with a safe way and the files to update, plus closed questions with their evidence.

tools.title: Lint and smoke-run a pack (gates S0, S5, S7)
tools.pass: exit 0 and last line '0 error(s), N warning(s)'
tools.summary: Runs the pack in real Lua 5.5 against a stub built from the contract, with the robot's rules (pools, transform gate, voice timing, hooks bound once, handle GC). Codes are listed at the top of the file.

tools.title: Headless demo run (gate S3)
tools.setup: cd tools && npm install && npx playwright install chromium
tools.pass: exit 0, no JS-ERROR line; writes pika-spec.json and shot.png
tools.summary: Plays a kit demo in headless Chromium and exports its spec and lints.

tools.title: Demo hand-off gate (gate S3)
tools.summary: Rechecks glyph coverage, file sizes, alias and path lengths and blocking lints; prints the To record list.

tools.title: PNG to .rgb565 image or frame strip
tools.pass: prints the Sprite.new(...) call to use
tools.summary: Converts PNGs to raw little-endian RGB565 as Sprite.new reads it; several same-size inputs make a strip.
